The fix is to parse that format explicitly and keep casting ISO strings as before.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH p AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '__/__/____ %' THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM p"}}
